scope: Controlled acquisition and technical validation of only three DataverseLV Alternaria NPZ cubes. No training, classification, or production integration.

source.title: Hyperspectral imaging (HS) of tomato leaves inoculated with Alternaria protenta
source.api_result: HTTP 200; latest version file list confirmed filenames, file IDs, published sizes, and MD5 checksums.

acquisition.download_method: Official Dataverse API access/datafile/{file_id} endpoints; temporary .download files were size/MD5-verified before moving to final names.

inspection.method: NumPy NPZ inspection with allow_pickle=False. No array was normalized, clipped, or otherwise modified.

axis_interpretation.basis: Observed shape 512x512x204 and source README convention of 512x512x204 with 204 bands.
axis_interpretation.confidence: inferred, not encoded or independently verified

inspection.distribution_assessment: All values are finite and nonnegative. Maxima (1928-2730) are much larger than means (0.186-0.209); 198748-465637 values per cube are greater than 1. Units/calibration are unknown, so this is flagged for author clarification, not labeled corruption or reflectance.

sample_mapping.source: F1 inspection of official metadata.tab, carried forward in the Phase F2.2 audit; mapping is external to these NPZs.
sample_mapping.mapping_confidence: high for TSV mapping, not encoded in cube files
sample_mapping.diagnostic_ground_truth: No per-cube laboratory assay confirmation or disease severity is present in the NPZ files or established by this metadata join.

compatibility.structural_compatibility: The arr_0 key, 3D numeric shape, and float16 dtype are structurally compatible with current project conventions.
compatibility.wavelength_aware_analysis: Not currently supportable; no per-cube wavelength vector or header data in NPZs.
compatibility.calibrated_reflectance_claim: Not supported; source description of calibrated cubes is not independently verified from these arrays, references, or processing formula.
required_separate_adapter: Load source-scoped files without reusing the 2436 wavelength vector.
Preserve DOI, file ID, trial, plant, isolate, leaf, part, and date via validated metadata join.
Record wavelength and calibration status as unknown until verified.
Do not attach Botrytis labels, masks, or reflectance-oriented output semantics.
scientific_limitations: No control cube is present among the three public NPZ files.
Only one mapped plant represents isolate 065; all three cubes are from trial 4.
No wavelength vector, calibration/reference data, or sample metadata arrays are embedded.
High maxima relative to means and values greater than 1 require radiometric explanation.
No disease severity or per-cube diagnostic verification was established.

phase_f2_2_correction.correction: The F2.2 JSON and narrative incorrectly stated that one of the three cubes was a control. The listed mappings (065/I, 028/IV, 028/II) and source TSV show all three are inoculated; none maps to a control.
phase_f2_2_correction.previous_conclusion_unchanged: Public cube subset is insufficient for valid classification evaluation.

final_decision.scope: Source-separated descriptive exploration after the wavelength axis, units, and calibration are author-verified.
next_phase: Request per-file ENVI headers/wavelength vectors, axis mapping, band ordering, bad-band handling, calibration formula, units, and reference associations.
Ask the authors to explain the large maxima relative to means and verify the external plant/trial/label mapping.
Obtain additional independent plant cubes, including controls, before any classification design.
Keep this dataset separate from Botrytis; make no reflectance, prediction, or forecasting claims.

validation.json_csv_validation: passed; manifest parsed and CSV has three consistent array rows
validation.git_diff_check: passed; no staged paths and raw NPZ files are git-ignored
